name: ChatBI V1.3 Phase5 Backend Core Data Golden 100

base_case_question_overrides.G21: 汇总冻结数据中全部订单的成本总额

extension_cases.question: 按产品统计订单量前3名，并列时按产品编号稳定排序
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS product, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name, p.product_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 3

extension_cases.question: 列出订单量最高的3个地区，并列必须按地区编号破除
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name, r.region_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, r.region_id ASC LIMIT 3

extension_cases.question: 按客户类型统计订单量，完整展示并列名次
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_type AS customer_type, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_type ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_type ASC

extension_cases.question: 退款订单量最多的前4个产品，数量并列按产品编号排序
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS product, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.status = 'REFUNDED' GROUP BY p.product_name, p.product_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 4

extension_cases.question: 按客户统计去重订单量前10名，验证第10名并列边界
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_name AS customer, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_order_count FROM demo_business.orders o JOIN demo_business.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.customer_id ORDER BY distinct_order_count DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 10

extension_cases.question: 找出单笔收入最大的一张订单，若并列取订单编号最小者
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue FROM demo_business.orders o ORDER BY o.revenue DESC, o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

extension_cases.question: 找出单笔收入最小的一张订单，若并列取最早订单编号
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue FROM demo_business.orders o ORDER BY o.revenue ASC, o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

extension_cases.question: 返回成本最高订单的编号和成本，稳定处理相同最大值
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.cost FROM demo_business.orders o ORDER BY o.cost DESC, o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

extension_cases.question: 返回成本最低订单的编号和成本，稳定处理相同最小值
extension_cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.cost FROM demo_business.orders o ORDER BY o.cost ASC, o.order_id ASC LIMIT 1

extension_cases.question: 统计最大购买数量以及达到该数量的订单数
extension_cases.expected_sql: WITH maximum AS (SELECT MAX(o.quantity) AS max_quantity FROM demo_business.orders o) SELECT maximum.max_quantity, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o CROSS JOIN maximum WHERE o.quantity = maximum.max_quantity GROUP BY maximum.max_quantity
